svg.title: GPU-accelerated quantum chemistry
svg.desc: Conceptual parallel electronic-structure computation: a carbon dioxide molecule above three identical GPU symbols. Branch arrows are computing-flow symbols and do not represent chemical bonds. CO2 source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Carbon-dioxide-3D-balls.png ; original rendering by Ben Mills (Benjah-bmm27), public domain. The original PNG is embedded unchanged, with uniform scale and translation only. No measured data or performance values are shown.
